test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the Public Enterprise survey 2018-19, which is the most profitable PSU in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ONGC.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **Public Enterprise Survey** is a comprehensive count of all **Central Public Sector Enterprises **(CPSEs). It collects vital statistical data on a variety of **financial and physical aspects** for all CPSEs.
 
• According to the Public Enterprises Survey** 2018-19**, which tracks all central PSUs' annual financial performance, the **top ten firms** in the **red** accounted for **94.04 percent** of the **total losses** incurred by all 70 loss-making CPSEs throughout the year.
 
• **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation **(ONGC), **Indian Oil Corporation**, and** NTPC**, the **top three profit-making PSUs**, contributed **15.3 percent, 9.68 percent, and 6.73 percent,** respectively, to the total profit made by all profitable CPSEs.
 
• For the third year in a row, **BSNL, Air India, and MTNL** suffered the **most losses.**
 
• The **total income** of all CPSEs in 2018-19 was **Rs 24,40,748 crore**, up from Rs 20,32,001 crore in 2017-18, representing a **20.12% increase.**
 
• Every year, the **Ministry of Heavy Industries & Public Enterprises',** **Department of Public Enterprises** (DPE) releases the Public Sector Enterprises Survey, which examines the performance of central public sector enterprises (CPSEs).
 
• According to the survey, there were** 348 CPSEs** in total as of **March 31, 2019,** with 249 of them functioning. The remaining 86 were under construction, with 13 in the process of being closed or liquidated.
